title: Stage2-L v10 responsibility-preserving objective redesign after MR2

amends_without_rewriting.role: formal data and held-out corruption protocol; all launch locks remain active

structured_target_determinism_audit.result: 400/400 group-variant summaries reconstructed exactly from U, R and K; learned structured-field classification is redundant supervision

responsibility_contract.stage1_adapter: Produces task-agnostic spatial observation uncertainty U only, including view, region, strength and temporal variation.
responsibility_contract.orion_vlm_first_pass: Learns task relevance R from clean visual and route/task context.
responsibility_contract.task_risk: K is defined as U multiplied by sigmoid(R); task relevance is not delegated to the Stage1 adapter.
responsibility_contract.language_path: Receives detached U and detached first-pass R through a trainable task-risk language bridge. QA gradients may update the bridge and language-facing ORION parameters but not U or first-pass R.
responsibility_contract.structured_answer_fields: Risk view, region, level, relevance level and stance are deterministically decoded from U, R and K. No learned structured-field head is permitted.
forbidden: corruption family labels as task relevance
collision or TTC labels in Stage1
native glare in adapter or Stage2-L training or checkpoint selection

A_map_pretrain.objective: Learn spatial R support from route/hazard geometry using calibrated foreground-balanced map loss, Tversky loss with stronger false-positive penalty, and foreground/background support hinges.
A_map_pretrain.exit_gate: Held-out spatial relevance support, foreground recall and background false-positive gates must pass before any risk-alignment phase. Extra routes or optimizer steps may not substitute for a failed objective.

B_risk_alignment.objective: Apply geometry-normalized on-path versus off-path ranking only to matched examples with identical U magnitude and support.
B_risk_alignment.exit_gate: Held-out on-path greater than off-path ordering must improve without degrading zero-UQ and background selectivity gates.

C_language_grounding.objective: Teach QA verbalization of deterministic U/R/K semantics with U and first-pass R detached.
C_language_grounding.exit_gate: Held-out QA consistency and map-to-answer faithfulness; language metrics cannot retroactively qualify a failed R map.

implementation.platform_test: 9 passed on the frozen ORION platform Python environment

unresolved_preflight.blocking_dependency: Identify a genuinely task-agnostic Stage1 U-tokenizer checkpoint or train the tokenizer using Stage1-only observation-uncertainty objectives, then freeze and hash it.
unresolved_preflight.prohibited_shortcut: Do not reuse the MR1/MR2 tokenizer after task/QA training as though it were a frozen Stage1 tokenizer.
unresolved_preflight.next_safe_action: Audit tokenizer checkpoint lineage and produce a zero-training preflight report before implementing or submitting the v10 trainer.

claim_boundary: This amendment records an objective and gradient-routing correction. It is not evidence that R has been learned, that the VLM understands U, that native glare is detected, or that closed-loop safety improves.
